sources.claim: Advertising Router identifies the LSA originator.
Network-LSAs are originated by the designated router for a transit network.
Summary-LSAs are originated by area border routers.
Type 4 ASBR-summary-LSAs are never originated into stub areas.
AS-external-LSAs describe external destinations and are not flooded into stub areas.
Stub areas do not carry AS-external routes.
Flooding is limited to interfaces eligible for that LSA and area scope.

levels.title: Keep it local
levels.briefing: Router and network LSAs describe one area. Trace their local audience.

levels.title: Diplomacy between areas
levels.briefing: ABRs summarize routes into a destination area. Follow the advertised instance.

levels.title: The town crier
levels.briefing: External LSAs travel through non-stub areas. Area 1 is now stubbed.

challenges.subject: J1's Area 1 links
challenges.hint: A Type 1 LSA stays inside its originating area.

misconceptionsByReasonCode.extra-or-missing-receiver: Type 1 LSAs stay in one area; a router in Area 0 does not receive this Area 1 instance.

challenges.subject: LAN-2 transit network and attached routers
challenges.hint: The DR originates it, then the Network-LSA is flooded in the area.

misconceptionsByReasonCode.extra-or-missing-receiver: The DR-attached list describes the transit network; eligible Area 2 routers receive the LSA through area flooding.

challenges.subject: A summarized network advertised into Area 0
challenges.hint: Grade this one Area 0 summary instance.

misconceptionsByReasonCode.extra-or-missing-receiver: A Type 3 summary instance is flooded within its destination area; its advertising ABR is the origin.

challenges.subject: Reachability to ASBR-A2 advertised into Area 0
challenges.hint: Follow the Type 4 instance into Area 0, not the ASBR's own area.

misconceptionsByReasonCode.extra-or-missing-receiver: Type 4 identifies an ASBR and this instance is flooded only within its destination area.

challenges.subject: An external destination from ASBR-A2; BGP-X is its fictional peer
challenges.hint: Check which routers have at least one regular-area path for this AS-wide LSA.

misconceptionsByReasonCode.extra-or-missing-receiver: Area 1 is stub, so its internal routers cannot receive Type 5; ABR-A1 still receives it in Area 0.
